title: Clarmi.studio
description: $10k/mo automated web agency that ran itself.

title: Moodle
description: No-code mobile app builder driven by continuous voice. Hands-free from idea to TestFlight.
fullDescription: Mobile-native Expo app where you build mobile apps. Continuous voice mode streams partial transcripts word-by-word into the AI, who edits the canvas live — drag-to-arrange components, visual edit overlays, data models, and workflows. Powered by an agent loop that auto-restarts after each AI response so you never touch a keyboard. Built on Expo + Supabase.

title: SkyHeart
description: Autonomous drone that finds you in a crowd & delivers medicine. ==TreeHacks 2026.==
fullDescription: Autonomous medicine-delivery drone. Streamed the drone manufacturer's app screen from an Android phone over USB to a PC running YOLOv8 person detection + AWS Rekognition face matching. The server sends back swipe gestures that get injected into the drone app via Android's Accessibility Service — phone's WiFi stays on the drone the whole time. All phone↔server traffic tunnels through `adb reverse` so no external network is needed.
